mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS usercnt FROM MEMBER
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT idn) AS activeuser FROM loginlog WHERE SSTIME > (SYSDATE-7)
SELECT COUNT(action_time) AS dailymatch FROM like_request_log WHERE ACTION_TIME BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND status = 'accepted'
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS gendercnt FROM member_profile group by gender
SELECT address, COUNT(*) AS addrcnt FROM member_profile GROUP BY address
SELECT COUNT(*) AS likecnt FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matchcnt FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{nickname} AND status = 'accepted'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS datecnt FROM date_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{nickname} AND status = 'accepted'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS norescnt FROM like_request WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{nickname} and STATUS != 'pending'
SELECT ROUND(tsum/total) AS avgsstime FROM( SELECT SUM(TO_CHAR(SSTIME, 'HH24')) AS tsum, COUNT(*) AS total FROM LOGINLOG WHERE IDN = #{num} AND STATUS = 'login')
SELECT COUNT(UNIQUE idn) AS dau FROM LOGINLOG WHERE SSTIME BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND STATUS = 'login'
SELECT COUNT(UNIQUE idn) AS wau FROM LOGINLOG WHERE SSTIME BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE)-7 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND STATUS = 'login'
SELECT COUNT(UNIQUE idn) AS mau FROM LOGINLOG WHERE SSTIME BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),-1) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND STATUS = 'login'
SELECT COUNT(UNIQUE idn) AS yau FROM LOGINLOG WHERE SSTIME BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE),-12) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND STATUS = 'login'
